title: Hindrance to Galle ɓooyɗo
intro: E nder wuro ceniingo ngoo, limre doole ina seerti e tikkere nde nulal kesal fuɗɗii saaktude. Oo neɗɗo, mo innde mum wonti ko nanndi e luulndaare goonga, ina ndaara batte maɓɓe ina ɓuuɓtoo e les teddeendi wahyu Alla. Hol ooɗoo ruuhu, mo baasal mum siifi e nder ceene nokku hare lolluɗo ?
clues: Miin ko mi mawɗo e nder leñol am, ganndiraaɗo jawdi am e doole am e nder wuro ngo ina waɗi nokku ceniɗo ɓooyɗo.
Nde gorko gooto jeyaaɗo e leñol am fuɗɗii haalde konngol Alla gooto, miɗo ƴattoo mo e wahyu makko, miɗo noddira ɗum tan ko haalaaji ɓooyɗi.
Mi fotndi e oon gorko nde o juulata saraaji suudu ceniindu nduu, omo hulɓina yoo o woppu dewal makko e doole so ina haani.
Miɗo jeyaa e ardiiɓe peewnitooɓe ngam silminde iimanaagal kesal, luulndaade almuɓɓe mum e konnguɗi e kaɓirɗe.
Mi yahdi e konu haa nokku ina wiyee Badr, miɗo hoolii wonde min ndartinat fedde tokosere gooŋɗinɓe.
Kono e oon nokku hare, nguurndam am arii haa timmi, maayde am wonti janngirde wonande 6e 6eydii 6eydude majjere caggal maandeeji laaɓtucfi.
verse: Have you seen the one who forbids (96:9)
